name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
summary: At Ratchet's docks, Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun keeps a cordial face toward Alliance travelers. He serves the Steamwheedle Cartel and resents the Theramore forces at Northwatch Hold for firing on his vessels.

sections.title: Privateer of Ratchet
sections.body: From Ratchet's docks, Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun leads the Thalo'dan Privateers under the Steamwheedle Cartel's banner. Ratchet welcomes merchants of every flag who bring coin, though trade along the Barrens coast carries danger. Northwatch Hold lies just south of the port, and its heavy cannons threaten neutral sea lanes. Brightsun remains cordial toward visiting travelers, but the garrison's attacks on his fleet have tried his patience.

sections.title: A Private War with Northwatch
sections.body: Brightsun cannot send his fleet against Northwatch Hold without endangering Ratchet's neutrality. Instead, he turns to capable Horde mercenaries to settle the score. Their strikes aim to silence the cannons and free his captured crew. By using Horde auxiliaries, Brightsun protects his shipping interests without provoking direct Alliance retaliation against the cartel or entering the conflict openly.

faq.answer: From Ratchet, Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun commands the Thalo'dan Privateers in service to the Steamwheedle Cartel.

faq.q: Why is he angry at Northwatch Hold?
faq.answer: Northwatch Hold's Alliance forces have repeatedly fired heavy cannons at Brightsun's merchant vessels and imprisoned his sailors, disrupting trade along the coast.

faq.q: Why does he only hire the Horde to attack Northwatch?
faq.answer: Brightsun remains diplomatic toward Alliance travelers in Ratchet, but cannot ask Alliance loyalists to attack their own stronghold. The Horde has reason to weaken Theramore's military outpost.

faq.q: Does he belong to the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Brightsun belongs to neither faction. His allegiance lies with the Steamwheedle Cartel and his privateers, though his current grievances bring his interests in line with the Horde.

angles.text: Brightsun gives the Horde a reason to strike Northwatch Hold and cripple Alliance naval artillery along central Kalimdor's coast.
Brightsun speaks cordially with you in port, but Northwatch Hold's Theramore forces have driven him to conspire in secret with your enemies.
